items.title: GE Vernova Is Up 18% in 2026 After Three Guidance Raises: Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova stock is up 18% in 2026, but it has slid since early July even though the company raised its 2026 guidance three times. The selling came from outside the company: Meta’s spending results and Democrats’ win in Congress hit AI power stocks, Vertiv included.

items.title: Industrial Stocks Drop Amid Fears of AI Data Center Slowdown
items.summary: Shares of industrial companies behind artificial-intelligence data center construction declined broadly on Thursday as investors signaled anxiety that the building boom will be curtailed.

items.title: Eaton CEO: AC to DC migration for data centers ‘is real’
items.summary: The electrical equipment multinational says it’s poised to capitalize on the trend by investing in solid-state transformers. But the “timing of that transition is not under our control,” said CEO Paulo Ruiz.
